content.title: 86th Parkway Sewer Line Project
content.summary: The 86th Parkway Sewer Line Project involves significant construction work to replace and upsize sewer lines, enhancing capacity for nearly a third of Arvada. Lane closures and rolling side street closures will occur on W. 86th Parkway and Moore Street, with work expected to last 10 to 12 months, beginning in January 2026. Residents should anticipate delays, limited access, and sidewalk and bike lane closures during construction hours.
content.body:
## Current updates

5/27/26

**Lane closures for repaving W. 86th Pkwy** (eastbound) starting at Yank moving east to Newcomb.

- Work is expected to take 3-4 weeks
- Rolling side street closures will be in effect as work progresses
- **25 MPH**through the work zone
  - **Please slow down**to help keep work crews and the traveling public safe
- **Bike lanes are closed**
  - Follow signage on site and use the sidewalks through the construction zone
  - Final bike lane striping eastbound will be completed at the end of the entire project to match the striping westbound

All work is weather dependent.

## Moore St. Construction Map of 4 phases of construction on Moore St moving north from 82nd Ave to 86th Pkwy

Updated 5/27/26

Work on Moore St., south of 86th Parkway began on Tuesday, May 26.

### Timeline

Each phase will begin after the previous phase is complete.

- **Phase 1 (W 82nd Ave to 83rd Place): 2-3 weeks**
- Phase 2 (W 83rd Ave to 84th Place): 2-3 weeks
- Phase 3 (W 83rd Ave to 85th Place): 2-3 weeks
- Phase 4 (W 84th Place to W 86th Pkwy): 2-3 weeks

### What to Expect

- Full road closure with local access only
- **Phase 1 will****limit****driveway access for the homes on Moore St.**
  - Trash cans will be moved by the contractor to a designated area for pick up
  - Coordination with delivery carriers (FedEx, Amazon, etc.) may be required
  - USPS mail will deliver to the common mailbox area uninterrupted
- No street parking within each phase
  - Driveway access will be maintained on side streets
- Sidewalk closures on Moore during working hours (7am - 7pm)
- Access to 86th Parkway from Moore closed during Phase 4 (all access via Miller St.)
- Truck traffic via Miller, 82nd Ave, and 83rd Place to Moore based on phase of construction (designated with black arrows on the map)

## Overview

This sewer line construction project includes four segment:

1. **W 86th Parkway**from Moore St. to Alkire St.
2. **Moore Street**from W 86th Pkwy to W 82nd Ave.
3. **Alkire Street** from just north of W 88th Ave. to W 86th Pkwy.
4. **W 86th Parkway** from Alkire to just west of Beech St.

The project will increase capacity and add resilience to the sewer system. The sewer line serves nearly a third of Arvada in the north and west portions of the city and has capacity limitations. The sewer line needs to be replaced and upsized to continue reliably serving the community.

System Development Charges (SDC) that developers pay to provide service to new development help to fund capacity needs for City utilities projects. This helps ensure that growth pays its own way in Arvada. Once connected to service, new customers pay rates and fees like everyone else. More information about long range planning and utilities funding is available on the [utilities transparency webpage](/661).

## Timelineproject area map from Moore Street along 86th Parkway to just west of Beech St and north on Alkire

Updated 1/6/26

Once construction begins, the project is anticipated to take **10 to 12****months** to complete. The project is expected to begin in**January 2026.**

- **Phase 1:**W. 86th Pkwy. (Moore St. west to Alkire St.)
- **Phase 2:**Moore St. (from 86th Pkwy. south to W 82nd Ave.)
- **Phase 3:**Alkire St. (90th Ave. south to 86th Pkwy.)
- **Phase 4:**W. 86th Pkwy. (Alkire to west of Beech St.)

## What to Expect

- Working hours 7 am to 7 pm
- Single lane closures on 86th Pkwy.
  - East and westbound traffic will be maintained with a single lane in each direction
- Side streets may be closed at 86th Pkwy as work progresses
  - Follow detour signage on site
- Sidewalk and bike lane closures on the south side of W. 86th Pkwy.
- Expect delays and reduced speeds through the work area
- Potential temporary full road closure of Alkire St. during pipeline installation
- Full road closure (local traffic only) of Moore St.
- Repaving will be completed in areas where work took place
- Additional construction noise and traffic

## Contact

Please submit a ticket through [Ask Arvada](/898) and a team member will be in touch.
